8_faq_set.q: Do you deliver office furniture to Kitchener?
8_faq_set.a: Yes. Brant Business Interiors delivers and installs commercial office furniture throughout Kitchener and Waterloo, and the wider Region of Waterloo alongside Cambridge. We're a family-owned Ontario dealer headquartered in Peterborough, and we coordinate a delivery window for your site, then place, assemble and level everything with our own installation crew.

8_faq_set.q: Does Brant Business Interiors have a showroom in Kitchener?
8_faq_set.a: No. We're headquartered at 296 George St N in Peterborough and serve Kitchener as a delivery and installation coverage area, not a storefront. You work with our Ontario account team by phone and email, and our crew comes to your Kitchener site to deliver and install. Call 1-800-835-9565 to plan a project or request a quote.

8_faq_set.q: Is installation included on Kitchener orders?
8_faq_set.a: Professional assembly and installation is included with most orders. For larger fit-outs or after-hours and weekend work in occupied Kitchener spaces, any added scope is noted in your quote upfront — there are no surprise fees. Our crew places, assembles and levels every piece and removes the packaging the same day.

8_faq_set.q: How long does delivery to Kitchener take?
8_faq_set.a: Lead times depend on the product, not the location. Stock items typically deliver within one to two weeks; custom or made-to-order pieces run roughly four to twelve weeks by manufacturer. We confirm your delivery window at order confirmation and give advance notice before delivery day.

8_faq_set.q: Can Kitchener schools, hospitals and municipalities buy without a tender?
8_faq_set.a: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers in Kitchener — school boards, hospitals and municipalities — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Private businesses simply order direct. Call us and we'll confirm your eligibility.
